name: Micron LPDDR5X-8533 x16 single-die AAT IDD proxy

source.access: Table verified using web PDF reader; direct file download returned HTTP 403.

background_policy: native per-bank active/refresh time histograms, rho=0.5
row_policy: actual effective activation counts; combined incremental ACT/PRE energy
refresh_policy: duration-based refresh increments; convert average IDD5PB to paired-bank burst current
pim_array_proxy: one ordinary x16 BL16 core-column energy per accessed bank; MAC rows are reuse, not extra DRAM reads
caveats: Currents except IDD4RQ are worst-case specifications; IDD4RQ is a 25 C typical reference at 5 pF, RON 40 ohm.
Nominal voltages multiplied by the specified currents are a modeling proxy, not a measured average or guaranteed physical upper bound.
16-Gbit current parameters are used on the unchanged 8-Gbit simulator organization.
Ordinary DRAM core-column energy is a proxy for PIM internal access; vendor PIM-array power is unavailable.
AAT current values do not imply that the simulated workload runs at a particular temperature.
